_about: Declarative source of truth for the vendored AWS service models. botocore is pinned here; tools/sync-models.py snapshots ONLY the services listed below into models/<service>/<api_version>/ from that exact botocore release. The generator builds from the checked-in snapshot, so `cargo build` and the generator never need pip or the network. To add a service: add an entry, rerun the sync, review the diff. To bump every model: bump botocore_version + wheel_sha256, rerun the sync, review the diff. See README.md > Model sourcing.
